behavioral_evidence.value: Popularity-adjusted within-user sequential-window co-consumption profile for each item.

Using TRAIN split only, for each user collect distinct interacted items and accumulate pair counts C_ij (optionally within a fixed session/window); subtract marginal popularity with the stated log association score, retain top m positive neighbors, normalize, and derive soft memberships to K profile clusters. Compute/freeze profiles, anchors, and memberships before RQ-VAE fitting. No validation/test rows are inputs.

User-item sets, item frequencies, profile matrix, anchor clustering, and all cached memberships come only from training interactions plus the frozen item inventory/embeddings. Validation/test are evaluation-only; no their interaction, co-consumption, marginal, or assignment contributes to profiles, anchors, Sinkhorn targets, or SID construction.

geometric_necessity.value: Poincare exponential map and negative-curvature (-c, c>0) geodesic distance d_c, used in a behavior-conditioned transport cost; c is one fixed, predeclared curvature (e.g. c=1) for all points.
First-level quantization cost matrix before balanced Sinkhorn assignment; its output Q selects the first SID token and affects the codebook/encoder quantization gradients.

x_i=exp_0^c(z_i), e_j=exp_0^c(code_j), a_k=exp_0^c(anchor_k); T_ij=d_c(x_i,e_j)^2 + lambda*sum_k r_ik*d_c(e_j,a_k)^2; Q=Sinkhorn(exp(-T/eps), row=1, col=B/Kcode). Here r_ik is the behavior term and d_c is the curved term in one assignment pathway.

implementation_cost.claim: declared cost of the frozen run
implementation_cost.value: One-time sparse co-consumption construction O(sum_u |I_u|^2) on train user-item sets, top-m sparsification and O(N*m) storage; anchor clustering O(iter*N*m*K) once. Training adds O(B*Kcode*D) curved distances plus Sinkhorn O(S*B*Kcode) per minibatch, where S=5-10 iterations; current nearest-code assignment is O(B*Kcode*D). At frozen scale there are 24*3000=72,000 minibatches and 73,668,000 item presentations; added work is 72,000 Sinkhorn runs, each O(S*B*Kcode), with per-run distance cost O(B*Kcode*D). Profile and membership lookups are cached. Report measured epoch time; expected moderate constant-factor overhead, no extra Stage3 cost.

prior_work.value: Rather than transition-direction scoring, branch-conditioned curvature, or a separate pairwise behavior loss, this uses popularity-corrected train-only user co-consumption to define a small set of behavior anchors and performs batch-balanced hyperbolic transport directly into first-level codewords. The transport assignment itself changes prefix membership.
